content.short: Savings app paying on-chain yield on dollars, Bitcoin and gold, with no lock-ups or minimums.
content.description: Axal takes deposits in dollars, BTC or gold and lends them into on-chain markets, passing most of the interest back instead of keeping it as a bank would. Current rates are around 7.6% on cash, with yield accruing every second and withdrawals open at any time. Users can fund an account with Apple Pay, Google Pay, a card or one of over 500 banks, and the company is backed by a16z crypto and CMT Digital.
content.meta: Earn on-chain yield on cash, BTC and gold from a savings app with per-second accrual, instant funding and no lock-ups.
